item.title: R-Ladies+ Melbourne End of Year trivia event & 10th Birthday! - R-Ladies+ Melbourne
item.description:
Chapter: R-Ladies+ Melbourne

When: Wednesday, November 25, 2026 at 7:00 AM UTC

Where: DiUS

Attendees: 8 going

🎉 **R-Ladies+ Melbourne is turning 10!** 💜🎂 And what better way to celebrate a decade of R, data science, and community than with an R-themed Trivia Night! Join us for a fun evening of trivia, laughs, and a little friendly competition as we put our R knowledge to the test! There will be prizes!! From R basics and quirky coding questions to packages and data visualisation, there'll be something for everyone - whether you're an R newbie or a seasoned tidyverse enthusiast! ✨ No coding required, just bring your curiosity and competitive spirit! Most importantly, it's a chance to celebrate 10 years of R-Ladies+ Melbourne and celebrate the end of the year, reconnect with familiar faces, and welcome new members to our community. Food and drinks will be provided! 💜 Everyone is welcome to our celebration!

item.title: Big Data? No Problem! An introduction to arrow for R - R-Ladies PDX
item.description:
Chapter: R-Ladies PDX

When: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 1:00 AM UTC

Where: Lucky Labrador Brew Pub

Attendees: 6 going

Working with data that's too large, too slow, or too messy for regular CSVs? Join us for an introduction to the {arrow} package in R. We'll explore how Arrow and Parquet files can make large datasets faster to store, read, and analyze, all while using the familiar dplyr workflows you already know and love. Using Portland's Biketown data, we'll convert, query, and visualize millions of rides without breaking a sweat (or our laptops). Bring your laptop if you want to follow along.

item.title: Cuando los datos no son normales: Guía amigable de GLM para la ecología - R-Ladies Villahermosa
item.description:
Chapter: R-Ladies Villahermosa

When: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 10:00 PM UTC

Where: Online event

Attendees: 16 going

En el mundo real —y especialmente en ecología y biología— los datos casi nunca siguen una distribución normal perfecta. Conteos de especies, presencias/ausencias o proporciones suelen romper los supuestos de los modelos lineales tradicionales (LM). En este taller teórico-práctico, la **Dra. Marisol Martínez Ramos** nos llevará de la mano para entender e implementar los **Modelos Lineales Generalizados (GLM)** en R de una manera accesible, intuitiva y aplicada a problemas ecológicos. ### 🎙️ Sobre la ponente **Dra. Marisol Martínez Ramos** Especialista en ecología, análisis estadístico y modelación de datos aplicados a las ciencias biológicas. ### 📅 Detalles del evento * **Fecha:** Martes, 10 de noviembre de 2026 * **Hora:** 6:00 PM * **Modalidad:** Virtual (Google Meet) * **Costo:** 100% Gratuito > ⚠️ *El enlace a Google Meet se activará para las personas registradas unos minutos antes de iniciar el taller.* ### 💜 Sobre R-Ladies R-Ladies es una organización mundial que promueve la diversidad de género en la comunidad de R. Todos nuestros eventos son gratuitos y se rigen bajo el Código de Conducta de R-Ladies Global. ¡Comunidad abierta a todos los niveles de conocimiento!

item.title: Developing your data visualisation skills in ggplot2 - R-Ladies Abuja
item.description:
Chapter: R-Ladies Abuja

When: Wednesday, January 20, 2027 at 4:00 PM UTC

Attendees: 9 going

In this session, we’ll be working through the process of developing a visualisation in ggplot2. We’ll start with a brand new dataset and create some exploratory plots; sketch out some ideas and decide what we want to communicate; build a basic plot in ggplot2; and then refine our chart to create something that’s artistic and aesthetic, yet effective. Some basic knowledge of the tidyverse will be helpful, but all of the code in this session will be explained and made available afterwards.
